gloss: casebook; case file; record of incidents

definitions.gloss: casebook; case file; record of incidents
definitions.explanation: A book or record documenting cases, incidents, or investigations. Used both for actual case records in legal and investigative contexts, and as a title format for mystery fiction and TV shows.

examples.japanese: {名探偵|めいたんてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事件簿|じけんぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the casebook of the great detective.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{事件簿|じけんぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{未解決|みかいけつ}→未解決：17292_mikaiketsu⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This casebook contains records of past unsolved cases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{事件簿|じけんぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}して→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧、⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{共通点|きょうつうてん}→共通点：03051_kyoutsuuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: The police reviewed the case files to check whether the perpetrator's methods had anything in common.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (incident, case) and {簿|ぼ} (register, book of records). The suffix {簿|ぼ} appears in many record-keeping compounds such as ⟦{帳簿|ちょうぼ}→帳簿：07961_choubo⟧ (account book) and ⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧ (name list). Very commonly seen as a title element in Japanese mystery fiction and detective shows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事件簿|じけんぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to examine the case files
- {事件簿|じけんぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}る→載る：27882_noru⟧: to be recorded in the casebook
- ⟦{未解決|みかいけつ}→未解決：17292_mikaiketsu⟧{事件簿|じけんぼ}: cold case files

CULTURAL NOTE:
The word is widely recognized from manga and anime titles like {金田一少年|きんだいちしょうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事件簿|じけんぼ} (The Kindaichi Case Files), making it familiar even to people who do not work in law or investigation.
